Thomas — thanks again for taking the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: We covered FinBank's primary goals around reducing inference cost for real-time fraud scoring, maintaining sub-150ms p99 latency, and gating sensitive customer data to your VPC. We also flagged integration points for your model ops team and procurement timeline.
- Ask: Schedule a 30-minute product demo / technical intro where Dev (our SE) can show a short hands-on flow and we can discuss integration patterns.

Suggested 30-min demo slots (all PT):
1) Tue, Mar 23 — 11:00–11:30 AM PT
2) Wed, Mar 24 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT
3) Thu, Mar 25 — 2:00–2:30 PM PT

Please let me know which of the above works best, and who from your side should join (I recommend including your CTO and one engineer from modelops). I’ve CC'd Marissa (Solutions) to help coordinate and will loop in Dev Patel for the technical deep-dive if we confirm.

Thanks,

rachel.kim@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0187
